data.title: Get Involved with Animal Rescue in Pittsburgh
data.subtitle: At the heart of Animal Advocates is our dedicated team of volunteers. With no compensated staff, the collective efforts of our volunteers is invaluable to saving the lives of animals in need across the Pittsburgh region.

data.title: Foster a Cat or Dog
data.text: Provide temporary in-home care for animals awaiting adoption. Ideal for families and students. We provide supplies and vet care.

data.title: Cat Caretaker & Animal Transportation
data.text: Provide basic care and socialization at headquarters. Transport animals to vet appointments and between shelters/homes.

data.title: Thrift Shop Sales
data.text: Staff the West End boutique, price merchandise, and welcome customers. Provides our largest single revenue source.

data.title: Fundraising & Outreach
data.text: Plan and staff fundraisers, community outreach events, and advocacy programs to support animal welfare.

data.title: Requirements
items: Must be 18+ or accompanied by parent/guardian
Sign volunteer agreement and liability waiver
Attend orientation training at Animal Advocates headquarters

data.title: Can't Commit to a Scheduled Position?
data.text: Supporters who want to help but cannot commit to a scheduled position can host supply drives, donation drives, or community events.

data.title: Senior to Senior Foster Program — Pittsburgh
paragraphs: Our Senior to Senior Foster Program pairs senior pets with senior community members for fostering, helping both humans and animals thrive in their golden years. Animal Advocates covers vet care and supplies.

data.title: Benefits to Seniors
items: Companionship from a loving, calm pet
All supplies and vet care provided

data.title: Eligibility & How to Apply
data.text: The program is open to Pittsburgh-area seniors who can provide a safe, loving home for a senior pet. No prior pet ownership required.

data.title: Cool Story: Connie & Chester
paragraphs: "Chester has brought so much joy to my life. As a senior myself, having a calm, loving companion makes every day brighter. The Senior to Senior program is truly special."
